_about: Known flaky timing checks (SCREAM-203). A FAIL whose name contains one of these is reported as FLAKY and doesn't fail the suite, so a red run means something real. Each entry: the suite, part of the check's name, and why. Fix the check and remove it from here; don't add to this list without a ticket number.

feel.name: rolls down to a creep only after about 10 s
feel.why: frame-rate dependent; fails on main in the cloud workspace

feel.name: keeps creeping (never stops on its own)

obstacles.name: and stops on the pothole
obstacles.why: spin timing; also fails on main

obstacles.name: Damage shows in the HUD as a red popup
obstacles.why: popup caught a frame late on a slow machine

buy.name: B returns to the truck once stock is bought
buy.why: the loading screen is sometimes still showing

pause.name: the customer's patience stops too
pause.why: off by one second; fails on main (November 5)
